RuleTitle: 2. Absolute Maximum Ratings and DC Operating Characteristics
ConditionText: Specifications in this section must be strictly followed to prevent thermal damage or logic failure.

During the power-up sequence, VCC must reach a stable voltage within 10ms. The Chip Enable signal (CE#) must remain High (VIH) until VCC reaches the minimum operating voltage of 2.7V. If VCC drops below 2.2V (Brown-out state), the internal reset circuit is activated immediately to prevent data corruption.
When the applied voltage on VCC exceeds 3.6V, the internal controller shall issue a protection lock and disable all Write/Erase operations.

When Error Code E-404 (Over-current / Motor Overload Signal) is asserted by the host system, AUX_PWR must remain supplied at 5.0V for at least 30 seconds to complete the internal safe-discharge sequence. Opening the module cover or cutting AUX_PWR before 30 seconds have elapsed may cause permanent electrical damage to the microbump array.
